title: RPG Maker MZ Freezes after opening tutorial interface

posts.author: Lyzya
posts.body:
Basically every time I open the Tutorial interface RPG Maker MZ will freeze after I perform any action, for example starting the tutorial 1 and creating a new project will freeze the program, also opening the tutorial interface, closing it and doing right click on any tile will also freeze the programs.
Basically no matter what, opening the Tutorial interface will result on the program freezing, happens every time.
Any idea of what I could do? I already reinstall the program multiple times but it didn't work.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I've never heard of anyone having that problem.
You might want to e-mail customer support for any technical advice they can offer.
Just a random thought because I think I recall it's caused issues with the tutorial in MV - is your display scaling in Windows at a level other than 100%?

posts.author: Lyzya
posts.body:
Yes, it was at 125% tho changing it to another resolution scale didn't fix the problem.
Hopefully costumer support can help me fix the issue, worst case scenario at least I hope is a tutorial exclusive problem
Edit: If anyone knows a good tutorial I could use to learn the basic I would be very thankful
